packageRules.description: Actions minutes are scarce: at most one weekly PR per repo for automergeable updates and one for minors. Named groups below still win for their packages; majors stay separate.
Hook revs in .pre-commit-config.yaml (prek): one PR per repo.
setup-gradle v6+ must keep cache-provider: basic (the default caching is proprietary); a major bump needs review, never automerge.
Template updates (copier, JakobMelchard/template) can touch CI, hooks and configs at once: review, never automerge.
Our own reusable workflows are consumed at @main on purpose; never digest-pin them.

Low-risk updates merge on their own once CI is green. Renovate's own automerge, not GitHub's: native auto-merge needs branch protection, which the free plan does not enforce on private repos. A repo with no passing check never automerges.
